# BowTeleport BowTeleport| Minecraft Bedrock Edition | Nukkit | API 1.0.13 --- **Description:**
> * BowTeleport is a simple teleportation Nukkit plugin. It allows you to teleport to the place your arrow/snowball landed. --- ***Features:***
:star: You can enable or disable teleportation with the `/bowtp` command;
:star: `Config`;
:star: You can enable or disable teleportation with `snowball` or `arrow`;
--- **Installation:**
:black_square_button: Place plugin's .jar file into `plugins` folder on your server;
:black_square_button: `Configure` in Config;
:black_square_button: `Launch` the server;
--- **Usage:**
:unlock: To enable teleportation type `/bowtp` into the chat;
--- **all Information** | Command | Permission | Descripton | config | | --- | ------|-----| -------| |bowtp| reyd.bow |It allows you to teleport to the place your arrow/snowball landed|Support| --- > * Link to cloudburstmc article -> [CloudburstMC](https://cloudburstmc.org/resources/bowteleport.798/) --- ``` Reporting bugs: If you come across a bug, please report it here or on cloudburstmc. ```
